events_detected.title: Operation Economic Outcast — US unveils sweeping 'economic D-Day' sanctions on Iran
events_detected.summary: Treasury Secretary Bessent unveiled 'Operation Economic Outcast' — sweeping new sanctions on Iran to 'tighten the noose' on every source of Iranian revenue. Trump promised an 'ECONOMIC D-DAY.' Iran's top security chief (Mohsen Rezaei) threatened to halt ALL oil movement through the Strait of Hormuz if neighbors help the US weaken Tehran's economy. New sanctions aimed at closing loopholes in the US financial dragnet around oil trade. Major escalation of the 2026 Iran war into the economic/financial domain.

events_detected.title: US sold euros to buy yen — first coordinated US-Japan FX intervention in a generation
events_detected.summary: US Treasury sold euros to buy yen, strengthening JPY from 164 to ~155. Yen has since weakened back to 159. Intervention aimed to prevent Japan from selling US Treasuries. First joint intervention in a generation.

events_detected.title: WHO declares Ebola PHEIC — fastest-growing outbreak on record, 5,290 cases, 2,516 deaths
events_detected.summary: WHO declared 2026 DRC Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. 5,290 confirmed cases, 2,516 deaths as of Aug 19. ECDC epidemiological update published 24 Aug 2026. No approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo strain. Risk in Europe remains very low.
